search_text: published ZDI-23-691 ZDI-CAN-17823 Canonical ksmbd-tools SRVSVC Null Pointer Dereference Denial-of-Service Vulnerability 2023-05-17 7.5 AV:N/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:N/I:N/A:H ['Canonical'] ['ksmbd-tools'] This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Canonical ksmbd-tools. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of the SRVSVC_OPNUM_GET_SHARE_INFO opcode. The issue results from dereferencing a NULL pointer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system. title: Canonical ksmbd-tools SRVSVC Null Pointer Dereference Denial-of-Service Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows remote attackers to create a denial-of-service condition on affected installations of Canonical ksmbd-tools. Authentication is not required to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the processing of the SRVSVC_OPNUM_GET_SHARE_INFO opcode. The issue results from dereferencing a NULL pointer. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to create a denial-of-service condition on the system.
